sql: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2) AS n_items_g2, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 WHERE main_cat LIKE '%Electronic%' OR main_cat IN ('Camera & Photo','Cell Phones & Accessories','Car Electronics','Home Audio & Theater','Computers','Video Games')) AS elec_maincat, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fdbk_g2) AS n_fdbk_g2, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NULL) AS null_usd
SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name IN ('items_g2','fdbk_g2')

rows:
CREATE TABLE items_g2 (
    ref_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    ttl TEXT,
    avg_rtg REAL,
    prc INTEGER,
    prc_usd REAL,
    str_nm TEXT,
    main_cat TEXT,
    feat_lst TEXT,
    img_ct INTEGER
)

CREATE TABLE fdbk_g2 (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    item_id TEXT,
    ref_id TEXT,
    uid TEXT,
    rtg REAL,
    ttl TEXT,
    body TEXT,
    ts INTEGER,
    hlp_ct INTEGER,
    vrf TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (ref_id) REFERENCES items_g2(ref_id)
)

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_reviews, SUM(rtg IS NULL) AS null_rtg, MIN(rtg) AS mn, MAX(rtg) AS mx FROM fdbk_g2

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd > 50) AS usd_gt50,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc > 5000) AS cents_gt5000,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NULL AND prc IS NOT NULL) AS usd_null_cents_notnull,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL) AS cents_null_usd_notnull
SELECT main_cat, COUNT(*) c FROM items_g2 GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY c DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS disagree FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL AND prc <> prc_usd*100;
SELECT prc, prc_usd, ROUND(prc/prc_usd,4) AS ratio FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL AND prc <> prc_usd*100 LIMIT 15
SELECT ROUND(MIN(prc/prc_usd),4) mn, ROUND(MAX(prc/prc_usd),4) mx, COUNT(*) c FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd>0

WITH r AS (
  SELECT ref_id, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(rtg) AS avg_rtg FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY ref_id
)
SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r JOIN items_g2 i ON i.ref_id=r.ref_id WHERE i.prc_usd>50 AND r.n>=5 AND r.avg_rtg<3.0) AS usd_strict,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r JOIN items_g2 i ON i.ref_id=r.ref_id WHERE i.prc>5000 AND r.n>=5 AND r.avg_rtg<3.0) AS cents_gt5000,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r JOIN items_g2 i ON i.ref_id=r.ref_id WHERE i.prc>=5000 AND r.n>=5 AND r.avg_rtg<3.0) AS cents_ge5000,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r JOIN items_g2 i ON i.ref_id=r.ref_id WHERE COALESCE(i.prc_usd, i.prc/100.0)>50 AND r.n>=5 AND r.avg_rtg<3.0) AS coalesced
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM fdbk_g2 f WHERE f.ref_id NOT IN (SELECT ref_id FROM items_g2)

WITH r AS (SELECT ref_id, COUNT(*) n, AVG(rtg) a FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY ref_id)
SELECT i.ref_id, i.main_cat, i.prc, i.prc_usd, i.avg_rtg AS item_avg_rtg, r.n, ROUND(r.a,3) AS review_avg
FROM r JOIN items_g2 i ON i.ref_id=r.ref_id
WHERE i.prc_usd>50 AND r.n>=5 AND r.a<3.0 ORDER BY r.a

WITH r AS (SELECT ref_id, COUNT(*) n, AVG(rtg) a FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY ref_id)
SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r JOIN items_g2 i ON i.ref_id=r.ref_id WHERE i.prc_usd>=50 AND r.n>=5 AND r.a<3.0) AS ge50,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r JOIN items_g2 i ON i.ref_id=r.ref_id WHERE i.prc_usd>50 AND r.n>=5 AND r.a<=3.0) AS avg_le3,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r JOIN items_g2 i ON i.ref_id=r.ref_id WHERE i.prc_usd>50 AND r.n>5 AND r.a<3.0) AS n_gt5
